# Fred J. Hickernell

::: {.affiliation}
Professor of Applied Mathematics\
Illinois Institute of Technology
:::

::: {.lead-copy}
My research straddles computational mathematics and statistics. I investigate how to find computational answers more efficiently and more reliably,
especially when a problem involves many variables or uncertain inputs.
My work connects Monte Carlo and quasi-Monte Carlo methods, numerical
approximation, and scientific software.
:::

## Bio {#bio}

::: {.bio}
Much of my career has been at Hong Kong Baptist University and Illinois
Institute of Technology.

My primary identity is as a follower of Jesus. My wife, Elaine, has been walking with me for over fifty years. We are blessed with two adult children by birth and two more by marriage. Elaine and I serve at [Wheaton Chinese Alliance Church](https://www.wcac-cma.org/). My years living in Hong Kong are an important part of my story.
:::
